newsitem.title: USA: Illinois county to use bonds to acquire building.
newsitem.headline: Illinois county to use bonds to acquire building.

text.p: Cook County, Ill., Board President John Stronger announced Tuesday the county would issue debt to purchase a downtown Chicago office building.

The acquisition of the building, which the county plans to use to consolidate county offices, would be financed through the issuance of short-term debt, according to county chief financial officer Tom Glaser. He added that debt would eventually be turned into long-term debt through a future county bond issue.
The county has agreed to purchase the 35-story building for $39.7 million, according to a news release from the county.
Glaser said the county plans to close on the real estate deal by yearend.
